mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes despite negative FEDFUNDS signals, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening, raising discount rates and compressing equity present value, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes despite high FEDFUNDS signals, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.
